evidence_items.content: SandbornらはDMSMS陳腐化を元メーカーから部品を調達する能力の喪失として扱い、長寿命システムと短寿命部品のライフサイクル不一致を問題とする。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 部品の過去の陳腐化イベントと、導入済みでまだ陳腐化していない部品の両方の記録から調達可能期間を推定する方法を提示する。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 2021年のrisk-based原著は、現時点で調達可能である条件の下で指定ホライズン以内に陳腐化する条件付き確率をモデル化し、MTTFベース手法と遡及比較する。全文詳細は未照合。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: ADS研究は既に生産終了したZenerダイオード2366部品を選び、16数値・21カテゴリ説明変数を整理した。予測targetは導入日からLTB日までの期間である。
evidence_items.source_locator: Section 4.1 Data Collection and Problem Description
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: ADS研究は学習集合を類似部品の重複しうる部分集合へ分割し、各部分集合の回帰モデルから新しい部品に最も近いモデルを選ぶ。学習／テストの配分は80％／20％。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: Moonらの研究はZener・varactor・bridge rectifierの3種ダイオードを対象に、k-meansによる類似クラスタと複数回帰モデルのhybridを用いてEOL日予測の誤差を比較した。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 2026年のレビューは188文献中、予測手法を扱う研究を21件（レビュー1件を除く）と整理し、数理的ライフサイクル・確率モデルとデータマイニングを主要系統として記述する。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 同レビューは予測手法が大量で正確なデータに依存する一方、実際のデータには欠測、古さ、誤記、不十分な品質があり、特徴量選択や仮定のバイアスが精度を損ねうると指摘する。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 自動車補修部品1709品番の消費履歴、保証故障率、車両残存台数推定等を用い、EOL期における今後8年間の部品需要量を予測する機械学習フレームワークを提案・評価している。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: 自動車補修需要の予測比較でRandom ForestがSafe MAPE 4.36％を報告した。これはEOL期の需要予測誤差であり、正規調達終了日の予測誤差ではない。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: RenesasはNRNDを新規設計採用非推奨、EOL-notifiedを生産終了決定と最終発注依頼済みとして区分する。
evidence_items.source_locator: Supply Policy & Product Lifecycle: NRND / EOL
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: Renesasは一般にEOL通知を生産終了12～24か月前とし、通知から6～12か月のLTB受付、LTB後およそ6～12か月の生産継続を説明する。品番別の例外はありうる。
evidence_items.source_locator: Supply Policy & Product Lifecycle: EOL Notification and Shipment
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: TIは通常のdiscontinuance時、最終発注まで12か月、さらに最終納品まで6か月の期間を設けるとし、早期終了の例外では通知で理由と日程を示す。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: NXPではNRNDで既存顧客の受注は継続し、生産終了の意思決定はまだない。EOLではLTB期日まで受注可能、NLMでは新規受注も製造も行わない。
evidence_items.selection_reason: 予測方法・予測target・評価上の適用条件と限界を示す。

evidence_items.content: Solomon, Sandborn and Pecht (2000) propose electronic-part life cycle forecasts including years-to-obsolescence and stages, using market and technology factors and dynamic sales data; DRAM integrated circuits are the example. The public author abstract does not report a prospective test of original/authorized-channel actual procurement unavailability.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F002 methodological families

evidence_items.content: Ma and Kim (2017) describe three steps for flash-memory life-cycle curves: time-series alignment by part family, Box–Cox transformation, and time-series modeling. Their target is a life-cycle curve, not directly the final authorized-procurement date; the abstract reports numerical example but no comparable out-of-time accuracy for target EOL.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F002 methodological families

evidence_items.content: Dubos and Saleh (2010) use Markov-chain and Monte Carlo models for risk of on-orbit obsolescence of spacecraft and technological maturation. The event is technology obsolescence on spacecraft, not part-number purchasing availability; its transition probabilities cannot be transported to component EOL as validated empirical parameters.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F002 methodological families

evidence_items.content: Mastrangelo and Olson (2024) describe a Weibull-based conditional probability approach to component obsolescence risk; changing product life, dynamic binning, Weibull regression, sample bias, and substantial censoring are discussed; a multiplexer dataset demonstrates feasibility. The public abstract does not establish forecast calibration for automotive authorized procurement end dates.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F002 methodological families

evidence_items.content: DigiKey distinguishes distributor-specific 'Discontinued By DigiKey' from manufacturer status: DigiKey can stop carrying a product while it remains active at the manufacturer. Thus distributor catalog delisting and manufacturer production-end are distinct events.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 catalog-signal observability

evidence_items.content: DigiKey explains manufacturer part-status reviews may be annual, quarterly, monthly etc. and that distributors often learn changed status at or near the update. It does not quantify an empirical interval from catalog delisting to final LTB/EOL across parts.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 catalog-signal observability

evidence_items.content: Nexar's part API exposes homogenized lifecycle status, underlying manufacturer raw status, and last-updated information for individual part status. The article describes current values and metadata but not a complete longitudinal catalog-inclusion history or delist-to-LTB lead-time distribution.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 catalog-signal observability

evidence_items.content: Accuris defines 'Discontinued' as not available and includes a 'Reactivated' status for parts previously listed EOL or Discontinued; it provides life-cycle stage, estimated years-to-EOL, and prediction-date fields. The documentation does not describe catalog delisting as an equivalent EOL date.
evidence_items.source_locator: Life Cycle and Life Cycle Risk sections
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 catalog-signal observability

evidence_items.content: An industrial empirical investigation of electronic chip shortages/obsolescence reports that termination and LTB information can be incomplete, and the available data may not yield usable statistical models. Its indexed abstract does not test distributor catalog removal as an EOL predictor.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 catalog-signal observability

evidence_items.content: The clustering-based hybrid diode paper's collected Zener fields include 'Part Status', 'Part Introduction', and 'Obsolete Date (LTB Date)' under categorical feature listings; varactor and bridge rectifier tables include 'Part Status'. The table alone does not specify per-feature prediction-time availability or prove that LTB date was fed to the model as a predictor.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: The hybrid diode work uses selected discontinued component observations: 2366 Zener, 350 varactor, and 307 bridge-rectifier parts. This sample does not represent a prospectively observed active-parts cohort with censored survival times.
evidence_items.source_locator: Section 4.1 Data Collection and Problem Description
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: The hybrid diode model clusters training records, fits DT/RF/GB-type regressors and selects clusters for test observations; grid search and error comparisons are described. The public article sections cited do not establish a historical as-of-date split or publication-time feature snapshots.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: The ADS paper builds 2366 discontinued Zener records from QTEC and Z2Data; the lifetime target is the interval between part introduction and LTB date. The categorical data table includes Part Status, Part Introduction and Obsolete Date, but target derivation is described separately from the input feature preparation.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: The ADS article evaluates regression against MRE/RMSRE and compares clustering/ADS against other regressors using known LTB-labeled records. It does not provide a clearly defined operational prediction as-of-date and corresponding historical feature availability audit in the passages checked.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: For 198 non-discontinued Zener parts, the ADS paper verifies that no predicted LTB date lies in the past; because true LTB dates are unknown, this sanity check does not establish prospective date prediction accuracy or survival calibration.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F003 input/target as-of-date audit

evidence_items.content: The 2026 review enumerates Gaussian lifecycle (Solomon), Markov-chain spacecraft obsolescence (Dubos/Saleh), Weibull conditional risk (Mastrangelo et al.), time series lifecycle curves (Ma/Kim), and data mining/ML as distinct literature strands; comparability requires separating event definition and inputs.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F002 family taxonomy

evidence_items.content: Accuris documentation lists a prediction date for life-cycle estimates and estimated years to EOL; metadata are attached to a prediction run, not a direct statement of observed final buyability for each part number.
evidence_items.selection_reason: Review 000001 repair: F001 status metadata provenance
